FN-MDV21H1-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 124
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Margie Wilcox
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: «Released Date»
House Bill 124 as introduced would: (1) create the Alabama Board of Optometry Fund in the
State Treasury to receive all deposits of the Alabama Board of Optometry codifying the
Governor's Executive Order No. 726; (2) create the limited residence license to codify the
current practice of licensing student residents; (3) increase the obligations of the board by an
estimated $10,500 annually by increasing the per diem for board members; and (4) decrease the
obligations of the board by an estimated $4,000 annually to allow the board to contact licensees
by common carrier or electronic mail, in lieu of certified mail for certain notices.
This bill would also provide for the continuance of the board until October 1, 2029 pursuant to
the Alabama Sunset Law.
